thread.title: Thursday's ETF with Unusual Volume: DJD

author: BNK Invest
title: Thursday's ETF with Unusual Volume: DJD
text:
Shutterstock photo The Invesco Dow Jones Industrial Average Dividend ETF ( DJD ) is seeing unusually high volume in afternoon trading Thursday, with over 2.3 million shares traded versus three month average volume of about 30,000. Shares of DJD were down about 1.2% on the day.
Components of that ETF with the highest volume on Thursday were Apple ( AAPL ), trading down about 8.2% with over 60.0 million shares changing hands so far this session, and Microsoft ( MSFT ), down about 2.4% on volume of over 20.3 million shares. Verizon Communications ( VZ ) is the component faring the best Thursday, higher by about 0.9% on the day.
